citation: Ilett, Hazlehurst, Jiang, Ma, Hogg and Roberts (2026), Reconstruction of 3D crystal growth from transmission optical microscopy images - Supporting data, University of Leeds.
clock_provenance: The article reports five-minute imaging intervals. Per-frame acquisition timestamps and dropped frames are not yet independently transcribed. Nominal elapsed times are assumptions; actual acquisition times remain null.
split_policy: Whole runs; all 20-degree replicates share a conservative condition family. Runs 12 and 14 were used for pilot source/label inspection and remain training/development data. Validation/test images are not used for visual tuning. This tests within-source transfer, not an independent laboratory/campaign.
